references.text: The people regarded John the Baptist as a prophet, which reflects Herod's fear of the people concerning John in Matthew 14:5.
Herod feared the people's reaction because they viewed John as a prophet, similar to how the leaders feared the people when considering arresting Jesus because they regarded him as a prophet.
Herod respected and protected John, even though he ultimately executed him, which mirrors his conflicting feelings in Matthew 14:5.
